test.create_query: CREATE DICTIONARY cache_dictionary_warm ( id UInt64, value_int UInt64, value_string String ) PRIMARY KEY id SOURCE(CLICKHOUSE(DB 'default' TABLE 'cache_dictionary_source_table')) LAYOUT(CACHE(SIZE_IN_CELLS 4194304)) LIFETIME(MIN 100000 MAX 200000);

CREATE DICTIONARY cache_dictionary_expiring ( id UInt64, value_int UInt64, value_string String ) PRIMARY KEY id SOURCE(CLICKHOUSE(DB 'default' TABLE 'cache_dictionary_source_table')) LAYOUT(CACHE(SIZE_IN_CELLS 4194304 ALLOW_READ_EXPIRED_KEYS 0)) LIFETIME(MIN 1 MAX 2);

CREATE DICTIONARY cache_dictionary_small ( id UInt64, value_int UInt64, value_string String ) PRIMARY KEY id SOURCE(CLICKHOUSE(DB 'default' TABLE 'cache_dictionary_source_table')) LAYOUT(CACHE(SIZE_IN_CELLS 65536 ALLOW_READ_EXPIRED_KEYS 0)) LIFETIME(MIN 100000 MAX 200000);
test.query: SELECT sum(dictGetUInt64('cache_dictionary_warm', 'value_int', number)) FROM numbers(2000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM numbers(2000000) WHERE dictGetString('cache_dictionary_warm', 'value_string', number) = '1' FORMAT Null

SELECT sum(dictGetUInt64('cache_dictionary_expiring', 'value_int', id % 1000 + 1000 * (toUnixTimestamp64Milli(now64()) % 2000))) FROM cache_dictionary_source_table SETTINGS max_threads = 16 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(dictGetUInt64('cache_dictionary_small', 'value_int', (id * 7919) % 2000000)) FROM cache_dictionary_source_table WHERE id % 2 = 0 SETTINGS max_threads = 16 FORMAT Null
